issues.on_page: Supplies and Other column total 17,441,873 = statement Supplies and other 11,103,735 + Employee benefits and payroll taxes 4,409,154 + Depreciation 1,928,984
issues.issue: Schedule 2's 'Supplies and Other' column includes employee benefits. Only 276,376 of the 4,409,154 is recorded as benefits, so supplies and materials in detail is overstated by about 4.13M across the department lines.

issues.on_page: Nursing service - Hospital (row) x Salaries and Wages / Supplies and Other (columns)

issues.on_page: Due from third-party payors: Estimated third-party payor settlements 48,326
issues.issue: Third-party payors include private insurers as well as Medicare/Medicaid, so receivables is equally defensible. The matching liabilities[6] (1,125,683) is likewise recorded as due to other governments.
